Market today: The mood is clearly fearful, driven by widespread tech outages and a confirmed market rotation away from growth into defensive stocks. This directly impacts your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-78.18%), MUU (-61.79%), and SMCI (-44.99%) are in deep trouble with 'SELL' statuses. Your leveraged ETFs are decaying and their default stops are clearly broken. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the S&P 500's technical floor (headline 10) and continued tech sentiment. Any further weakness there will hit your portfolio hard.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk and reduce exposure to your most vulnerable tech positions.
plays: Your SOXL stop at 200 is completely out of touch with its current price of 49.04. Re-evaluate and set a realistic stop for SOXL immediately to prevent further uncontrolled losses.
Similarly, your MUU stop at 31.6 is far from its current 14.21. Adjust your MUU stop to a realistic level to manage this deep loss.
Given the tech downturn and flight to defensive stocks, consider a new long position in SOXS (inverse semiconductors) at its scanner entry 58.7-58.64 with stop 58.13 as a hedge.
